mainEntity.name: Will Website AI Discovery Files help with voice search optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Website AI Discovery Files are highly beneficial for voice search optimization. Voice search relies heavily on AI to understand natural language queries and provide precise, contextually relevant answers. By providing AI models with a clear semantic map of your website's content, these files enable your site to be better understood and matched with conversational voice queries. This improves your chances of appearing as a direct answer or a top result in voice search outcomes, enhancing your visibility to users of smart speakers and voice assistants.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, they help by providing AI models with a clear semantic map of your content, making your site more understandable and relevant for conversational voice queries.
